dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature; the spline fits an inward arc from the basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a small-radius rounded vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior incline of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon with a steep, small-radius curvature transitioning directly into the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio and a tapered tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Extremely obtuse angle with no visible crease, indicating a smooth, continuous melon-to-rostrum transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small V-shaped notch is visible on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin; faint, light-colored linear raking scars are present on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark dorsal cape; pointed, falcate pectoral fin; broad caudal flukes with a clear median notch.
